attributes.text:
Money you’re owed,
recovered by AI.

Overpaid scans your receipts and statements for forgotten subscriptions, missed refunds and price drops, then its agents claim every dollar back with your approval. Fees sit in Cardano escrow until the money lands.
Powered by Cardano, Masumi, x402 and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
Overpaid works for everyone too busy to chase their own money. Its AI agents catch the overcharges businesses count on you missing, and get every dollar back.
See every overcharge before it costs you again.
Drop in receipts and statements. Overpaid shows one number: the money you’re owed, and exactly where it’s hiding.
No more paying for things you forgot you had
Cloud browser agents cancel, claim and dispute on merchants’ own sites, in parallel. You approve every step.
No more evenings on hold with support.
Experts on call, paid on results.
When a claim needs expertise, Overpaid hires a specialist agent on Masumi. Its fee waits in Cardano escrow until you’re paid.
No more paying for effort that didn’t work.
Track every dollar that comes back.
Every recovery is logged with evidence, plus an on-chain receipt wherever money moved.
No more wondering if the refund ever landed.

FAQ.YR6I3p2g6: Overpaid is a team of AI agents that recovers money you’re owed: forgotten subscriptions, missed refunds, price drops and duplicate charges. It finds them in your receipts and statements, then claims every dollar back on the merchants’ own sites, with your approval.
You drop in receipts and statements. Overpaid reads them, matches each purchase against merchant policies, and shows one number: the money on the table, with a reason for every line.

FAQ.gwbLlU2PH: What can Overpaid fix for me?
FAQ.YR6I3p2g6: It cancels subscriptions you no longer use, requests refunds for duplicate charges, claims price adjustments, and opens claims for orders that never arrived.
Anyone with more subscriptions, receipts and cards than time. It is built for busy people who would rather not spend evenings on hold with support.

FAQ.gwbLlU2PH: How is Overpaid different from a budgeting app?
FAQ.YR6I3p2g6: Budgeting apps show you charts. Overpaid goes to the merchants' own websites and gets the money back, while you watch and approve.
Each fix runs in its own cloud browser on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. Several run at once, follow a recipe for each merchant, and capture evidence as they go.
Some claims, like airline compensation, need expertise. Overpaid hires a specialist agent from the Masumi registry and pays its fee into escrow on Cardano.

FAQ.gwbLlU2PH: When does a specialist get paid?
FAQ.YR6I3p2g6: The fee is locked in escrow. The specialist submits proof of the result, and the fee releases after the unlock time unless Overpaid raises a dispute first.
People who pay for the same thing pledge together on Cardano. Providers see the pledged demand and bid for everyone at once, and each member is refunded the difference.

FAQ.gwbLlU2PH: What do I need to get started?
FAQ.YR6I3p2g6: An email export of your receipts and a card or bank statement. Overpaid processes them for you only.

FAQ.gwbLlU2PH: Do I need a crypto wallet?
FAQ.YR6I3p2g6: Only for specialist fees and bloc pledges, which settle on Cardano. Finding money and fixing it on merchant sites works without one.
Overpaid works on merchants' own websites through a recipe for each one. Hard cases go to specialist agents.

FAQ.gwbLlU2PH: Do I sign in to merchants myself?
FAQ.YR6I3p2g6: Yes. You sign in through a live view of the browser, and the agent continues from there. Overpaid never stores your passwords.
Receipts are processed only for you, redacted before any model sees them, and deleted on request. Overpaid never sells your data.

FAQ.gwbLlU2PH: Can a web page trick Overpaid into paying?
FAQ.YR6I3p2g6: No. The browsing agent has no wallet and no payment tools. Payments only happen in a separate service, for structured offers from Overpaid itself, within your limits.

FAQ.gwbLlU2PH: Does Overpaid do anything without asking?
FAQ.YR6I3p2g6: It finds and prepares on its own. Cancellations, disputes, deposits and payments always wait for your approval.
Finding money is free. Overpaid takes a success fee only on money that actually comes back to you.
